sector_model: royalty/licensing biopharma (ENHANZE drug-delivery platform plus product sales); use earnings, royalty concentration, cash flow and debt; not an insurer/bank model
thesis: Halozyme licenses ENHANZE (rHuPH20) to partners and earns royalties (Q3 2026 royalties 341.0M, +44%; DARZALEX 153.5M, VYVGART Hytrulo 88.1M, Phesgo 34.3M). Q3 revenue 493.0M (+39%), operating income 295.0M, 9M net income 627.0M (+36.8%), 9M OCF 679.2M with capex 11.0M; FY2026 guidance raised (revenue 1.860-1.925B, non-GAAP EPS 8.75-9.05, issuer-defined). Shares fell from 130.34 (11-04) to 102.92 (11-09 close), about -21%, after the 11-05 release. At 102.92: market cap about 11.7B, 24.2x TTM GAAP net income (485.4M, depressed by Q4 2025 acquired IPR&D of 284.9M and a 48.7M impairment), about 15x with the IPR&D added back, TTM FCF yield about 7.5% on basic-share market cap, EV about 14.0B using principal debt.
counterthesis: Royalties are concentrated in three partner products (about 85% of Q3 royalties by the three named lines; DARZALEX SC alone 45%) and partners can terminate on 90 days notice. Royalty rates step down after rHuPH20 patents expire; the 10-K states MDASE patents expire 2032-2034 but the rHuPH20 expiry that triggers the step-down was not isolated. 3.31B of convertible principal (1.5B issued Sept 2026) against 1.07B cash and marketable securities; stockholders' equity is negative (-55.2M) after buybacks and repayments; GAAP EPS is diluted by convertible shares (diluted 2.01 vs basic 2.17 in Q3); 400M buybacks in 2026 at about 79 average vs the current price. Merck SC Keytruda (Keytruda Qlex) dispute: a Dutch court granted an injunction in Oct 2026 but outcomes in other jurisdictions are unread, and a loss would remove upside while a win is not in earnings. Cause of the roughly 21% post-earnings decline not confirmed from a primary source (search snippets only mention a muted reaction to outlook). Cash flow includes working capital swings (receivables -87M, inventory +51M).
invalidation: Evidence of a royalty step-down or patent invalidation on DARZALEX SC/VYVGART SC/Phesgo, a partner shifting to a competing delivery technology, a material adverse ruling in the Merck matter, slowing partner product sales, or debt service stress as 2027-2028 notes mature (about 308M principal remaining).
